notes: The heading is printed three times; the third version lists codes AS954/AS954B/AS954C/CE954 while the first two list AS954/AS954C/CE954. The section covers both the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement with one shared requirements list.

The program learning outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole (degree and certificate); the A.S. degree shares them. They are copied as printed, including run-together words such as 'neededto', 'totroubleshoot' and 'ofcomputer-controlled'.
Every course is labeled '( Historical )' in the catalog, which may mean the course records are archived versions; a reviewer should confirm that the requirements are current for 2026-2027.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (AUT-50); these match the closed-list codes (AUT 50, etc.).
The degree text mentions general education requirements 'as described in the college catalog' but does not name a specific GE pattern.
